  readings: includes GST | excludes GST
  engine comparison: If it includes GST, 4 options are feasible (3 within the approval limit); if it excludes GST, 5 options are feasible (4 within the approval limit). 1 option changes outcome. For example, “3-month commitment · single payment at start” is rejected when it includes GST but feasible within the limit when it excludes GST.
- fact: approvalScope
  about: Whether the approval limit of ₹60,000 applies per payment or to the whole contract
  readings: applies per payment | applies to the whole contract
  engine comparison: If it applies per payment, 5 options are feasible (4 within the approval limit); if it applies to the whole contract, 5 options are feasible (3 within the approval limit). 1 option changes outcome. For example, “Full annual scope from May 2027 · 12 monthly payments” is feasible within the limit when it applies per payment but feasible but needs MD approval when it applies to the whole contract.
